name: Chalk user-facing job and webhook failures
description: The summary group preserves each user-facing failure message. State comes from read-only Postgres snapshots; no IDs or customer payloads are exported.
aplQuery: ['${LOG_DATASET}'] | where chalk_alert_stream == 'production-state-v1' | summarize arg_max(_time, chalk_alert_value) by chalk_alert_rule, chalk_alert_summary | summarize value=max(chalk_alert_value) by chalk_alert_rule, chalk_alert_summary

name: Chalk API requests or Sync connections are failing
description: Users are seeing API requests fail, or failing to connect or repeatedly reconnecting to a Space; start with `pnpm diag trace <32-hex-trace-id>` from an affected response or connection. API: more than 0.05 5xx/s over five minutes. Sync: more than ten upgrade rejections or WebSocket closures over five minutes. Require five consecutive one-minute evaluations.
aplQuery: ['${LOG_DATASET}'] | union ['${TRACE_DATASET}'] | where (['service.name'] == 'chalk-api' and ['attributes.event'] == 'http.request' and ['attributes.status'] >= 500) or (['service.name'] == 'chalk-sync' and name in ('sync.http.upgrade_rejected', 'sync.websocket.closed')) | extend rule=iff(['service.name'] == 'chalk-sync', 'sync', 'api'), weight=iff(['service.name'] == 'chalk-sync', 3, 2), summary=iff(['service.name'] == 'chalk-sync', 'Users are failing to connect or repeatedly reconnecting to a Space; start with `pnpm diag trace <32-hex-trace-id>` from an affected connection.', 'Users are seeing API requests fail; start with `pnpm diag trace <32-hex-trace-id>` from a failing response.') | summarize value=sum(weight) by rule, summary

name: Chalk production alert state is stale
description: Chalk cannot prove all four job and webhook alert snapshots arrived in the last five minutes. Check chalk-alert-state.timer, its service journal, Postgres access and Axiom ingest. Missing state is not success.
aplQuery: ['${LOG_DATASET}'] | where chalk_alert_stream == 'production-state-v1' and chalk_alert_rule in ('recording', 'export', 'transcript', 'webhook') | summarize value=dcount(chalk_alert_rule)
